title: A-N1: object measures robust to incomplete gold on the G2-B outputs (registered secondary analysis)
status: DRAFT for the judge (PD-16 final ruling). Registered only if committed before the first computation of the statistic on G2-B data, and only as computed by the committed score_an1.py
does_not_change: any G2-B prediction, verdict rule, kill rule, family or gold; score_g2b.py, the G2-B prereg and the confirmation map stay byte-identical
tier: registered secondary; body only, never the abstract or conclusions as confirmatory (map section 6; PD-16 item 1)
preconditions: all registered G2-B decodes present with sidecars (prereg runs)
scope: NEW-BACKBONE test on development images, not image-out-of-sample: CV295 is part of COCO-2500, XM600 is the Paper A XM3600 image set, UV231 is UIT-ViIC test (PD-16 item 4; binding 3). UV231 follows prereg exposure.uv231_handling: a FAIL counts, a PASS is never counted as support

scope_given_verified_negatives.text: The claim holds given verified negatives. On CV295 and UV231 the negatives are U80 minus the image's instance classes, the exhaustive complement of the complete gold, so cF1 carries complete-gold negatives at every ladder level and part of the shrinkage on those sets is by construction. XM600's OIV7 absent labels are not exhaustive, so XM600 is the informative set.
scope_given_verified_negatives.registered_sets: score_an1.py reports the same counts per set: sets.<set>.primary_analysis.diagnostics_all_images

family: LADDER (prereg families.<set>.LADDER), clean subset as for G2B-E1/E2/O1
lexicon: the primary lexicon of each set (score_g2b.score: the first lexicon); uv231's secondary lexicon is not analysed (DESIGN.md D7)

verified_negatives.coco80: U80 minus the instance classes of the image (U80 = the 80 classes of score_coco_probe.load_vi_terms)

measures.cF1: condensed F1: precision over judged mentions J = G | (N - G), registered recall; equals F1 at the complete level (DESIGN.md D3)
measures.bpref: bpref_set, trec_eval min(R, N) form, random order of the mentioned classes

primary.statistic: Q = theta * Range_F1 - Range_cF1; Range = max - min over the three gold levels of the OLS slope of 100 * measure on ln M over LADDER (score_g2b.stat_slope)

theta.derivation: STAGE1_PLAN.md section 3 step 5 applied to cF1: max over the stage-1 sets of sets.<set>.measures.cF1.rho[1][1], rounded up to a multiple of measures.STEP, capped at measures.CAP

deviation_from_stage1_plan.reason: stage1_diagnostic.json (computed after the choice was seen): bpref_set / R is close to 1 on every set (bpref_over_R_median), so bpref_set's larger shrink comes mostly from dropping precision, a near form of degenerate case D1 the rule did not screen; cF1 keeps precision, equals F1 under complete gold, and has the larger stage-1 rho, so the deviation makes the test harder
deviation_from_stage1_plan.note_pd16_final: bpref_set's Q is now reported per set as a descriptive output without a verdict (descriptive_bpref_set_Q)

descriptive: slopes per level, Range and rho for F1, cF1 and bpref_set; the non-primary candidate's Q at theta; unjudged shares, D2 and D6 counts; every statistic on all images (sensitivity); no verdicts

descriptive_bpref_set_Q.same_as_primary: theta, bootstrap draws, clean LADDER subset, gold levels and lexicon
descriptive_bpref_set_Q.verdict: none; bpref_set enters no verdict(), outcome() or kill rule
descriptive_bpref_set_Q.code: score_an1.py analyse_set (descriptive_Q_at_theta); sha unchanged, see code.score_an1

bootstrap: prereg analysis_plan.bootstrap: default_rng(design_constants.set_by_this_registration.bootstrap_seed).multinomial(N, [1/N]*N, size=design_constants.n_boot) over the clean LADDER subset in id order; CI percentiles design_constants.ci_lo_percentile and ci_hi_percentile

outcome_rule.text: NOT_TESTABLE if no set is PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE; NOT_SUPPORTED if 2 or more sets are FAIL (uv231 counts); SUPPORTED if cv295 and xm600 are PASS and no set is FAIL; MIXED otherwise

consequences.SUPPORTED: section 7 body, labelled registered secondary, per-set verdicts and the D1 scope (verified negatives needed); cF1 may be offered as the adoptable measure with that scope
consequences.MIXED: per-set verdicts verbatim; no general claim; cF1 stays exploratory
consequences.NOT_SUPPORTED: a registered negative; cF1 is not proposed (A-N1 kill); the IR framing stays as discussion
consequences.NOT_TESTABLE: the paper says the test was not run or not evaluable

proposed_commit_paths.stage1_record: manuscript/prereg/2026-10-19_an1_stage1/ (every other file of the task folder)

no_overwrite: measures.py, stage1_diag.py, score_an1.py and build_addendum.py refuse an existing output; a delivered file is never overwritten (a new version is _v2)
g2b_outputs_read: none; data/results/g2b/selfcheck.json is the only file read under data/results/g2b
paper_b_numbers: none; no Paper-B manifest is read
